title: Deep-link navigation logic duplicated between real arm and demo arm (still present since round 1)
detail: Round-2 hard blocker requires BOTH arms route through the pure notification_target_path/3. The real arm does (client.gleam:4399), but the demo arm re-implements routing inline. The helper lives in client.gleam, which imports demo_update (line 31) — demo_update cannot import it back without a cycle, so the placement forces the duplication.
recommended_fix: Move notification_target_path/3 (and resolve_application_vacancy) into a cycle-free module (e.g. helpers/notification_routing.gleam importing model, demo_store, routes) and call it from both client.gleam and demo_update.gleam.

title: Demo arm still never navigates vacancy-typed notifications while the real arm does (still present since round 1)
detail: The demo arm's case matches only Some("application"); a vacancy-typed notification click in demo mode falls through to no navigation, while the real arm navigates to /vacancies/<vid>. Latent today because demo fixtures (demo_fixtures.gleam:37) contain only application-typed notifications, but the deep-link contract says both entity types navigate in both arms.
recommended_fix: Route the demo arm through the shared notification_target_path/3, which handles the vacancy arm; the demo fixtures need no change.

title: leaderboard_vacancy_id is stamped at request time, not from the response — a reordered ApiReturnedLeaderboard response re-fabricates a wrong vacancy id
evidence:
ApiReturnedLeaderboard(result) ->
      case result {
        Ok(response) -> #(
          Model(
            ..model,
            leaderboard: Success(response.entries),
detail: ApiReturnedLeaderboard (msg.gleam:203) carries no vacancy id, unlike ApiReturnedLeaderboardRefresh which sets leaderboard_vacancy_id: Some(vacancy_id) from the response. If AppRequestedLeaderboard(A) then (B) fire and A's response lands last, A's entries are stored under tag Some(B) — the resolver then resolves A's applications to vacancy B, B1's fabricated-id bug via a race. There is no leaderboard request-id guard.
recommended_fix: Change the message to ApiReturnedLeaderboard(String, Result(...)) and set leaderboard and leaderboard_vacancy_id atomically from the response's own vacancy id, mirroring the ApiReturnedLeaderboardRefresh arm.
